candidates.statement: Applicants whose drug products are approved under the accelerated approval framework (section 235 506(c) of the FD&C Act, 21 CFR 314 (subpart H), and 21 CFR 601 (subpart E)) and applicants 236 with other products where such submissions are required for approval must submit promotional 237 materials to OPDP and APLB as required under section 506(c)(2)(B) of the FD&C Act, 21 CFR 238 314.550, and 21 CFR 601.45. Under section 506(c)(2)(B) of the FD&C Act, FDA may grant 239 accelerated approval of a drug product on the condition, among others, that the sponsor submit 240 copies of all promotional materials related to the product during the preapproval review period 241 and, following approval and for such period thereafter as the Agency determines to be 242 appropriate, at least 30 days before dissemination of the materials. Additionally, there may be 243 other situations when the Secretary of Health and Human Services 15 may establish 244 presubmission conditions on promotional materials similar to those in place for accelerated 245 approval products (e.g., section 564(e)(4)(A) of the FD&C Act). In such situations, like the drug 246 products approved under the accelerated approval framework, sponsors will be required to use 247 the format for electronic submission outlined in section VI of this guidance, no earlier than 24 248 months after publication of this guidance. 249
